entities.summary:
Koninklijke Philips NV is a Dutch multinational conglomerate corporation that has shaped the course of human history since its founding in 1891. As one of the world's largest and most successful companies, Philips has played a significant role in the development of modern technology, from the invention of the first commercial light bulb to the creation of cutting-edge consumer electronics.

The company's origins date back to the Philips & Co. factory in Eindhoven, Netherlands, where Frederik Philips began manufacturing carbon filament lamps in 1891. This early innovation sparked a series of breakthroughs that would propel Philips to global dominance.

Throughout its history, Philips has been driven by a commitment to innovation and collaboration. The company has consistently pushed the boundaries of what is possible, from the development of the first portable radio to the creation of advanced medical imaging technologies.

Today, Philips is a leader in a wide range of fields, including consumer electronics, healthcare, and lighting. With operations spanning over 60 countries, the company continues to shape the world we live in.

As one of the most successful companies in history, Philips has left an indelible mark on human civilization. From the invention of the first commercial light bulb to the creation of cutting-edge consumer electronics, this Dutch multinational conglomerate corporation has played a significant role in shaping the modern world.
